title: Will and Witness
author: Quentin Dravenmoor
blurb: Zephyrine Kavanagh, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
